title: TikTok — why 'on a program' moves the price
hook: "Enrolled on a program" — why those four words move the price.
body: The phrase that quietly protects your resale.

script.voiceover: 'Engines enrolled on a program.' Here's why that phrase moves the price.
Jet-engine overhauls run into seven figures, and they come due whether you're ready or not.
A program like Corporate Care or MSP turns that surprise into a predictable hourly rate — and it transfers to the next owner. That's why a program jet sells faster and holds value.
Always check program status before you fall in love. Vertical Jet Sales.
